stalls.zh: 灶頂原汁排骨湯高麗菜飯
stalls.en: Zaoding Pork Rib Soup & Cabbage Rice
stalls.summaryZh: 連年必比登推介，湯頭清甜不油、可續湯，高麗菜飯簡單耐吃；用國小課桌椅，很有懷舊感。
stalls.summaryEn: Multi-year Bib Gourmand pick: light, sweet broth with free refills and simple, satisfying cabbage rice, served at old school desks.

sources.title: Ken & Alice｜延三夜市必吃推薦（2026）

stalls.en: Lao Pai Zhang Pork Knuckle Rice
stalls.where: 民族西路296號；週一休（另有部分週日休）
stalls.summaryZh: 常被網友封為台北最強豬腳飯之一，皮Q肉嫩、入味不鹹；日韓旅客多，晚到熱門部位會賣完。
stalls.summaryEn: Often named among Taipei's best pork knuckle rice: springy skin, tender meat, not overly salty. Popular with Japanese and Korean visitors; favored cuts sell out late.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段58號；午、晚兩時段
stalls.summaryZh: 必比登推介，湯圓大顆、肉餡多汁，客家風蝦米油蔥湯底；香菇雞湯也常被點名，有人覺得皮稍厚。
stalls.summaryEn: Bib Gourmand pick with big, juicy pork tangyuan in a Hakka-style shallot broth; the mushroom chicken soup is also praised, though some find the skin a bit thick.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段41號；白天營業約07:00–16:00，週二休
stalls.summaryZh: 50多年老店、連年必比登，米糕軟而不黏，可選肥瘦，豬肝湯也有口碑；只開到下午，晚上逛夜市會撲空。
stalls.summaryEn: 50-plus-year shop and repeat Bib Gourmand: soft rice, fatty or lean pork, and a well-liked pork liver soup. Daytime only, so it's closed by night-market hours.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段3-3號附近；週二、三休（2024資料）
stalls.summaryZh: 40年老攤，大腸煎外酥內Q、配小黃瓜和甜辣醬，烤雞腿是常見加點；晚間常排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: A 40-year-old stall: rice sausage crisp outside and chewy inside, with cucumber and sweet-chili sauce; the grilled chicken leg is a popular add-on. Evening queues are common.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段85號；營業到深夜
stalls.summaryZh: 湯頭清爽鮮甜，適合在重口味之間換換口味，也是宵夜好選擇；炸物評價有好有普通。
stalls.summaryEn: Clear, sweet broth with fine rice noodles, a good palate-cleanser or late-night bite; opinions on the fried sides are mixed.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段30號；週二休（另有不定休）
stalls.summaryZh: 現煮麻糬沾花生粉、芝麻粉，Q軟不黏牙，冷熱交融的燒麻糬冰是飯後甜點首選。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh mochi rolled in peanut and sesame powder, soft but not sticky; the warm-mochi shaved ice is a favorite after-dinner treat.

stalls.en: Taipei Qiaotou Braised Pork Rice & Gua Bao
stalls.where: 延平北路三段24號；週二、三休
stalls.summaryZh: 反而以刈包和四神湯出名，常有人一次買一打以上；價格實惠，老闆夫婦動作慢但親切。
stalls.summaryEn: Better known for its gua bao and four-herb soup than the rice; some buy a dozen buns at once. Good value, with slow but friendly elderly owners.

stalls.where: 延平北路三段騎樓（各來源門牌不一）
stalls.summaryZh: 只賣蒸餃和酸辣湯，皮薄多汁、現包現蒸，自製辣椒醬受好評，酸辣湯帶黑胡椒香。
stalls.summaryEn: Sells only dumplings and hot-and-sour soup: thin-skinned, juicy, made to order, with a well-liked house chili sauce.
